name: edit_profile
description: Replace the caller's own 21st.dev public profile board (the bento layout at 21st.dev/@you). Owner-only - always writes YOUR account, there is no username argument. `blocks` is a FULL REPLACE (like `tags` on edit_component) - omitted blocks are dropped, so read the current board with get_profile first if you want to keep existing content. Pass `clear: true` instead of `blocks` to revert to the classic (non-bento) profile. The server auto-arranges blocks into a grid and validates every reference: `component` cards must be YOUR OWN public components (get their demoId from search with mine:true, or get_component), `library` cards must reference a public library owned by you or one of your teams, and `image` cards must point at a url returned by this account's own uploads (foreign image urls are dropped). Response includes `warnings` for anything dropped. Block vocabulary: {type:'component',demoId} shows a live component preview; {type:'ascii'|'template'|'theme'|'gradient',refId} references your published content; {type:'library',refId} links a personal or team library; {type:'social',url} is a link card; {type:'note',text} is a text card; {type:'hire'|'pro'|'support', headline?, body?, url?, email?, cta?} are profile CTA blocks; {type:'image',mediaUrl} shows a photo/GIF; {type:'divider'} splits the board into a new section. Every block accepts optional `w`/`h` (grid units, 1-3 wide / 1-2 tall).

blocks.description: Full replacement list of content blocks, top to bottom.

mediaUrl.description: image: a url returned by upload_profile_media (foreign urls are dropped).

clear.description: Revert to the classic profile (drops the saved board).

enabled.description: Explicitly show/hide the bento board without changing its content.
